objective: Implement one serialized filler-aware interruption loop that controls pause, continue and TurnChange

decisions.candidate_owner: One adapter interruption loop owns VAD, STT, timer, held transcripts and decision completion
decisions.output_controls: Internal PauseOutput, ContinueOutput and FlushOutput values
decisions.timer: A time.Timer is selected by the owner loop; no timer callback mutates or executes interruption work
decisions.filler: Filler-only interim text waits; ended filler-only speech continues at the deadline; meaningful text commits immediately
decisions.stt_order: Hold provider-ordered events, trim timed events before the overlap, and add no utterance ID
decisions.commit: The loop flushes local output and emits one TurnChange decision, then waits for completion before accepting another candidate
decisions.replay: Local EOS, TTS and LLM invalidation completes before held meaningful STT is replayed

acceptance: VAD start pauses once without rotating context
Meaningful gated STT emits one TurnChange decision
Filler-only ended speech continues at the deadline
Active speech commits at the deadline
Candidate output action completes before another candidate starts
Loop shutdown leaves no paused output or live timer
Direct text and word-trigger commits remain supported

later_required_slices: Add output admission, pause, continue and flush to every configured streamer
Add synchronous local EOS, TTS and LLM invalidation before replay
Add conditional lifecycle transition and stale model-result rejection
release_gate: Do not enable or release the first slice until every later required slice passes verification.
verification: just agent-finalize with exact changed paths
rollback: Revert the complete interruption change set and restore direct legacy VAD handling.
